newsitem.title: USA: Porta Systems hires independent accountants.
newsitem.headline: Porta Systems hires independent accountants.

text.p: Porta Systems Corp said on Friday it had hired the firm of BDO Seidman LLP as its independent public accountants to audit financial statements for the year ended Dec 31, 1995.
The company said the move followed an order by the Securities and Exchange Commission for a private investigation of Porta System's finances.

The SEC told the company that the independence of the company's prior auditors for 1995, KPMG Peat Marwick, was "adversely impacted by certain relationships involving the auditors and KPMG BayMark Strategies LLC, and Edward R. Olson, the President of KPMG BayMark Strategies who is also serving as the company's interim president and chief operating officer."

"As previously reported, the Company does not presently satisfy all of the American Stock Exchange's financial guidelines for the continued listing of its common stock. In the event that this situation is not remedied, there can be no assurance that the listing of its common stock will continue," it said.
